commits.message:
fix(prompt-runtime): remove 4 dead legacy prompts leaking into every registry listing

commit 8319c43 added a local fallback registry (registry.json) so
jf.resume.parse and jf.onboarding.profile-import.extract stay available
if Langfuse is unreachable. That's correct and unchanged here -- both
are marked "source": "local" and get properly overridden by Langfuse's
live version whenever Langfuse is healthy (list_prompts() merges
Langfuse over local, so Langfuse wins on ID collision).

The other 4 entries in that same file (resume_builder.summary_improve,
resume_builder.bullet_rewrite, matching.fit_explanation,
agents.support_reply_draft) are the original 2026-07-10 static registry,
retired when Langfuse replaced it on 2026-08-21. They have no Langfuse
counterpart, so nothing ever overrides them -- they leak into
GET /prompts/registry unconditionally, permanently, regardless of
Langfuse's health. Confirmed live before this fix: prompt_count was 42,
not the expected 38, and registry_version had silently reverted to the
pre-Langfuse static-registry string.

Removed the 4 dead entries. Updated the one check script and one docs
fixture that still referenced resume_builder.summary_improve, pointing
them at jf.resume.summary.generate (same "resume" domain, so the
fabrication-safety-blocking assertion still exercises the same code path
in app/prompt_runtime/safety.py -- verified that check is domain-based,
not prompt-ID-based, before making this substitution). Validated the
edited registry.json against the live PromptDefinition Pydantic model
inside the running hermes-api container before opening this PR.

No functional/merge-logic change -- app/prompt_runtime/langfuse_prompts.py
is untouched. Pure data cleanup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
